text:
jordan: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged a promo failure for release 2026.03.21 — artifact checksum mismatch vs registry and subsequent e2e job hung. blocking the cut. :frowning:

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion blocked: artifact-checksum-flip detected on gcr.redwood-inference/prod/release-2026.03.21. E2E job `staging-e2e-42` timed out after 45m. See logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/1799004321/logs

maria: ugh, saw similar last month. likely a concurrent reupload or partial multipart rejoin. can we take a quick diff of manifests? :eyes:

kevin: reupload race is my bet. GCS returned a 200 on compose but digest changed. quick check: `gsutil ls -L gs://artifacts-prod/release-2026.03.21/**` then compare digests. if mismatch, we should pin to last-good digest and re-run promotion.

sre-oncall: I pulled object versions — there's a compose op at 14:03 UTC that produced a different CRC than the original chunked upload (we have object generation IDs). I can temporarily mark the new object as quarantined.

jordan: quarantine sounds good. what's the blast radius if we pin to previous digest and promote? will any in-flight canaries pick the wrong blob?

maria: canaries use the image digest; if we promote with previous digest the canary pool will get the pinned blob. but we need to ensure the registry still serves the old generation id. if it was GC'd, we'd be stuck.

kevin: command to pin locally (dry-run):
```bash
# find last good manifest
curl -sS https://registry.redwood/v2/prod/release-2026.03.21/manifests | jq '.manifests[] | select(.annotations."redwood/last-green"=="true")'
# set promotion to digest
deployctl promote --repo prod --manifest-digest sha256:abcd1234 --force-pin --reason "pin last-green after checksum flip"
```

sam: alternative is purge registry cache and re-trigger the multipart finalize. but that's noisy during change window. I'd prefer pin+promote then run a verification job that curls the image digest from multiple regions.

maria: agree with pin+promote + verification. also update release notes and notify sales/customer channels about delayed rollout. small blurb: "promotion delayed for verification due to artifact checksum inconsistency."

jordan: ok provisional decision: pin to last-green digest (sha256:abcd1234), re-run staging-e2e as a priority job, leave canary disabled until verification passes. who will run the promote?

kevin: I can run it if SRE confirms the old generation is present. will also run `deployctl verify` afterwards.

sre-oncall: confirmed old generation is available in us-west1/us-east1 but asia has a lagging copy. I'll trigger a replication fix to ensure global availability. will tag the new object as quarantined so it won't be accidentally re-promoted.

deploy-bot: [automated] Manual promotion requested by kevin. Promotion queued: promote --repo prod --manifest-digest sha256:abcd1234 --requester kevin

kevin: running promote now. attaching command output in case of weirdness:
```text
2026-03-21T15:12:03Z promote: starting
2026-03-21T15:12:10Z registry: resolved digest sha256:abcd1234
2026-03-21T15:12:17Z promote: submitted to canary controller (disabled) -> waiting for verification
2026-03-21T15:12:20Z done (awaiting e2e)
```

sam: launching high-priority staging-e2e-42 rerun now. I bumped timeout to 60m and pinned to the digest.

maria: I'll draft a short release update and add a line to the release notes: "Rollback/pin plan executed to ensure artifact integrity; re-verifying canary prior to roll-out."

jordan: decision record: pin to sha256:abcd1234, quarantine suspect artifact, re-run e2e, delay canary until verification passes. I'll create a follow-up ticket for post-mortem with the artifact upload owners. :thumbsup:

kevin: e2e is running. if it passes we'll flip canary on manually and monitor the telemetry dashboards (latency/errors) for 30m before full cut.

deploy-bot: [automated] staging-e2e-42 rerun started by sam (priority: high). logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/1799004321/rerun

sre-oncall: replication fix in progress to asia, ETA ~12m. ping me if anything times out.

maria: ack. I'll publish the release note draft to #release-notes once kevin confirms green.

jordan: thanks everyone. keeping this thread pinned for release-manager visibility. if e2e flakes again we revert to last-stable tag and open rollback playbook.

kevin: update — e2e passed smoke checks at 15:45 UTC. will keep monitoring.

maria: publishing note now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion can proceed on manual trigger. current state: pinned to sha256:abcd1234, suspect object quarantined, e2e passed.

jordan: final: manual canary enable at 16:00 UTC, monitor 30m, then full promote if OK. closing hold. :white_check_mark:
